joint_initial_amount_base_one_disabled.description: Table 2 footnote 3: the fixed dollar part of the initial amount (added to the taxable disability income of the spouse under age 65) for a joint return where one spouse is 65 or older and the other is under 65 and retired on permanent and total disability.

joint_initial_amount_cap_one_disabled.description: Table 2 footnote 3: the maximum initial amount for a joint return where one spouse is 65 or older and the other is under 65 and retired on permanent and total disability.

joint_initial_amount_limit_base_one_unde.description: Special rules for joint returns: if only one spouse is under age 65, the fixed dollar part of the limit on the initial amount (the limit is this plus that spouse's taxable disability income).

agi_limit_single.description: Adjusted gross income limit for the credit for a single filer.
